entries.text: The polars-df and datafusion-df platforms now run the TPC-H throughput phase (concurrent query streams) and the RF1/RF2 refresh functions, so a full-specification `--official` TPC-H run works in DataFrame mode.
details: Each query stream binds its own per-position parameter seed, matching the SQL throughput test, and every query reads a snapshot of the table registry taken when it starts.

RF1 appends the new orders and lineitems; RF2 finds the rows to delete when it runs and registers filtered tables. The tables swap in one step, so a stream sees the state before or after a refresh, never a partial one.
The refresh stream runs one RF1/RF2 pair per query stream alongside the query streams and records the same evidence fields as SQL bundles.
